title: Main and Director have separate responsibilities
guidance: Main Assistant coordinates company-wide requests and sends scoped work to Executive/Studio Control. Director controls creative studio planning and the future production UI. Consolidation preserves all twenty department responsibilities; QC remains independent. Do not add duplicate supervisors or relocate the studio UI into Main as a permanent design.

review.approval_basis: Owner approved the read-only audit recommendations on 2026-10-18; guidance preserves existing authorities, not creative or spending grants.
